spatialgroups.configuration.title: Simple Voice Chat SpatialGroups
spatialgroups.configuration.enabled.tool: Turns on 3D audio for group members close to you. Turn it off to use plain Simple Voice Chat.
spatialgroups.configuration.spatial_dist: How far away you can still hear direction. 0 = use the server's voice distance.
spatialgroups.configuration.fade_distanc: The sound smoothly fades back to normal group voice over this distance. Bigger values = smoother.
spatialgroups.configuration.minimum_gain: Minimum volume at the edge of the 3D range, so the voice does not suddenly disappear.
spatialgroups.configuration.persistent_g: When on, groups stay after players disconnect or leave the server, and you rejoin your old group next time. A group you left on purpose will not pull you back in; once its last member leaves on purpose, the group is dissolved.
gui.spatialgroups.title: Simple Voice Chat SpatialGroups - Settings
gui.spatialgroups.range_unknown: Connect to a voice chat server to see your current range
